cohort: 50 women with singleton pregnancies undergoing emergency cervical cerclage (ECC) for cervical insufficiency with prolapsed membranes at 15 to 25 gestational weeks.
finding: Emergency cervical cerclage (ECC) resulted in a mean gestational age at delivery of 34.1 weeks and a mean neonatal weight of 2510.7g, demonstrating good perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study reported a high rate of vaginal delivery at 96%.
